slots.name: Gerard round score
slots.sentence: ATLANTA (AP) — Ryan Gerard hit it well enough for five relatively easy birdies Friday and dropped a surprise from just inside 80 feet for another, giving him a 5-under 65 and a share of the 36-hole lead with Viktor Hovland at the season-ending Tour Championship.

slots.name: Hovland total score
slots.sentence: He had a 66 to join Gerard at 10-under 130 going into the weekend.

slots.name: Scheffler round score
slots.sentence: That includes Scottie Scheffler, the world’s No. 1 player who had a 67 and was two back.

slots.name: Young round score
slots.sentence: And it included Cameron Young, in last place after the first round and atop the leaderboard for much of the day after a 62.

slots.name: Scheffler birdies
slots.sentence: Scheffler had two early bogeys to fall five shots behind and then answered with five birdies in a stretch of six holes around the turn to get back in the game.

slots.name: MacIntyre score gap
slots.sentence: MacIntyre shot a 76 — eight shots over the field average — and was 13 shots behind.

slots.name: Young turn score
slots.sentence: He made the turn in 30, and then poured in two more birdies to reach 7 under through 11 holes.

slots.name: Field separation
slots.sentence: The trophies — one for the Tour Championship and one for the FedEx Cup — are up for grabs at the halfway point.

slots.name: Gotterup total score
slots.sentence: Collin Morikawa and Chris Gotterup each shot 67 and were one behind at 9-under 131.

slots.name: Young first score
slots.sentence: He shot 70 that left him tied for last place and going off as a single Friday in the 29-man field (J.J. Spaun has withdrawn).

slots.name: Tour prize money
slots.sentence: Gerard has more on his mind than the $10 million prize and the five-year exemption on the PGA Tour.

slots.name: 15th hole distance
slots.sentence: Hovland had one of five birdies on the peninsula-green 15th hole, a par 3 at only 155 yards but tucked to the left near a sharp slope that feeds off the putting surface.

slots.name: Scheffler early bogeys
slots.sentence: He opened with two early bogeys in the opening round when everyone was going low and jokingly said it made him wonder about his career choice.

slots.name: Leaderboard shot gap
slots.sentence: One third of the field is separated by three shots on a course that has relatively soft with either rain Thursday or overcast Friday, even with a little wind late in the day.
